title: Spring constant calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates k = F/Δl with proper unit conversion from cm to m.

title: Work by elastic force
description: Essential: Correctly computes W = -½FΔl or equivalent, obtaining -10 J.

title: Potential energy change
description: Essential: Correctly states ΔEp = -W, obtaining +10 J.

title: Hooke's law application
description: Important: Recognizes that F = kΔl applies for spring elongation under tension.

title: Work integration reasoning
description: Important: Uses work formula for variable force (linear spring) rather than constant force assumption.

title: Energy-work relationship
description: Important: Correctly relates elastic potential energy change to work done by elastic force.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units throughout calculations (N, m, J).

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall: Forgets negative sign in work formula or misinterprets direction of elastic force.

title: Length unit mistake
description: Pitfall: Uses centimeters without converting to meters in spring constant calculation.

title: Constant force assumption
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly uses W = FΔl instead of W = -½FΔl for variable spring force.
